changes: HTTP bounded parsing, field validation, I/O deadlines and admission limits
SSE and nonstream request deadlines and cancellation
one persistent polling channel per model, batched token events, no per-request forwarding thread
terminal request reclamation independent of client acknowledgement; abandoned consumer expiry
typed shared KV allocation failures, separate client/owner/page management; explicit lock ownership
C++ and Python data client transaction deadlines and Python payload bounds
ServingRuntime separated from benchmark launcher and configuration parsing
ordered injectable shutdown coordinator and registered CTest suites
limitations: Real CUDA MPS is unavailable on this WSL/driver; MPS control paths are covered by mocks, not kernel-overlap execution.
Multi-GPU and NCCL execution were not available; current build has NCCL disabled.
Historical test_* suites are excluded from the main regression entry; passing CTest is not certification of every legacy test.
Control RPCs still use separate request sockets; shared KV owner RPC remains synchronous to preserve release acknowledgement ordering.
Microbenchmark values from different sessions vary; no end-to-end inference speedup is claimed.
intermediate_failures_fixed: Shared-page retire recursively acquired a nonrecursive mutex; corrected to collect_locked and verified by GPU reuse tests.
Lifecycle assertions previously assumed no phase events; now assert resource event ordering while allowing phase diagnostics.
An in-flight build missed a late Owner source edit; final validation used a completed frozen build.
performance_note: Repeated microbenchmarks show session/run variability. Persistent KV owner RPC remains a sub-millisecond operation, slower than purely local private allocation; no performance-neutrality or throughput improvement claim is made from these unpaired historical comparisons.
